intro: Messenger to Darkshire is an urgent diplomatic mission sent by Magistrate Solomon of Lakeshire to Lord Ello Ebonlocke in Duskwood. Desperate for military reinforcement against the Blackrock orcs and gnolls threatening Redridge, Solomon turns to his neighboring settlement for aid. The courier must brave the shadowed highways of Duskwood to deliver Solomon's formal plea to the mayor of Darkshire.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I require your assistance once again. I have written to Lord Ebonlocke, requesting that he sends his trained guards, the Night Watch, to help with Lakeshire's defense. It is imperative this message makes it to him swiftly. You must exercise extreme caution. Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire, in the heart of Duskwood. Do not stray from the roads.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You appear to have traveled from afar, adventurer. What business do you have here in Darkshire?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for making the long journey here. This is indeed important information.
